workflow: Approved meeting-action draft with human readback

scope.included: One synthetic action-summary workflow in one practice session
scope.excluded: Employment decisions, individual assessment, therapy and event operations

participation.alternative: Practise the action-summary rubric without personal reflection

outcome.task_definition: A synthetic action summary checked against the same five-item rubric
outcome.quality_rubric: All actions source-backed, owner and date present or explicitly unresolved, no invented facts, correct access scope

evidence.statement: A shared readback rubric may reduce missed action owners.
evidence.limitations: Synthetic rehearsal hypothesis; no efficacy or neuroscience claim.
